claimText: The appropriate ATS unit shall establish the transition level to be used in the vicinity of the aerodrome(s) and TMA concerned, based on QNH reports and forecast mean sea level pressure.
rationale: Mandatory obligation on ATS units to determine and establish the transition level.
exactSourceQuotes: The appropriate ATS unit shall establish the transition level to be used in the vicinity of the aerodrome(s) concerned and, when relevant, the terminal control area (TMA) concerned, for the appropriate period of time on the basis of QNH ... reports and forecast mean sea level pressure
